context_requirements: Functional GABAA receptor signaling machinery; most of these lines are not neuronal and may lack sufficient receptor subunit expression.
Membrane depolarization or second-messenger coupling sufficient to alter transcription within 6-24 h.
Absence of confounding high-level expression of unrelated chemoreceptor pathways.
falsifiers: Reproducible induction of canonical GABAergic immediate-early genes such as FOS, JUN, or EGR1 at 6 h in multiple lines.
Consistent dose-dependent transcriptional changes across several lines at 6 h or 24 h.
Enrichment of GABA-receptor or neuronal signaling signatures in the 978-gene landmark set.
